description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Seymour)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Seymour)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Evil Spear after using Dark abilities (max 3)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Seymour)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Seymour)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark abilities, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] and [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] after using Dark abilities

description.name: Dual Evil Spear
description.text: One single attack (11.28) capped at 39999/99999 if the target's Dark resistance has been lowered by 0-10%/20%+

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
